background: BNY is the holding company of the world's largest custodian bank, earning fees from safekeeping, settlement, asset servicing and investment management for institutions rather than from lending.
synthesis: As a holding company its ratings are a notch below the bank's: AA- from Fitch, A from S&P and Aa3 from Moody's, all stable, with Moody's upgrade to Aa3 on 5 Nov 2024 the latest move. Consolidated capital is mixed against US peers: CET1 of 11.9% is just below the peer median, while leverage of 6.7% is in the top quarter. LCR of 111% sits below the peer median. CET1 has risen 0.7 points since 31 Dec 2021 and the rest has been flat. The flagged news is a strong quarter on 15 Jul 2026 and a legal item on 29 Jun 2026.
